public.text: The decision not to catalogue technologies is sensible, but the chapter does not define a reusable assessment method that countries can apply to technologies not discussed explicitly.
public.suggestedRevision: Introduce a technology-assessment framework covering health need, evidence, data dependencies, interoperability, safety, equity, legal basis, human oversight, operational capacity, cost, environmental impact, supplier dependency, and exit options.
